His practice has grown organically through patient trust and word-of-mouth, reflecting his commitment to authentic healing rather than promotional visibility. He is known for identifying the root cause of diseases and treating patients through a combination of herbal medicines, Panchakarma therapies, and lifestyle modifications.
Dr. Pathak has extensive experience in treating chronic and lifestyle disorders, especially diabetes, hypertension, joint pain, digestive disorders, and stress-related conditions.
He is the Director of the Innovative Ayurvedic Diabetic Club (established in 2004), a unique initiative dedicated exclusively to the Ayurvedic management of diabetic patients.

An accomplished author, he has written the book “Panchakarma for Healthy Life”, which was awarded Best Ayurvedic Book (2003) by Panchakarma Niramay Sanghat. He has also co-authored a well-known book on diabetes, contributing significantly to Ayurvedic literature and awareness.
With his blend of traditional wisdom and modern psychological understanding, Vd. Sohan Pathak offers a truly holistic healing experience to his patients.

Panchakarma is one of the most powerful and specialized healing therapies in Ayurveda. It is a comprehensive detoxification and rejuvenation process designed to eliminate accumulated toxins, restore the balance of the body’s Doshas (Vata, Pitta, and Kapha), strengthen immunity, and promote overall health and well-being.

At Shraddha Ayurvedic Clinic, our Panchakarma therapies are carefully customized according to each individual’s body constitution, health condition, and wellness goals. Under the guidance of experienced Ayurvedic doctors, we provide authentic Panchakarma treatments that support physical healing, mental relaxation, and long-term vitality.
Abhyanga is a traditional Ayurvedic massage performed using warm medicated herbal oils selected according to the individual’s body constitution and health condition.
This therapy nourishes the tissues, improves blood circulation, reduces muscle stiffness, and promotes deep relaxation.

Shirodhara is a calming Ayurvedic therapy in which a continuous stream of warm herbal oil is gently poured onto the forehead. This therapy deeply relaxes the nervous system and helps restore mental balance.
Swedana is a therapeutic herbal steam treatment that induces sweating and helps open the body’s channels to release toxins.
It is often combined with Abhyanga to maximize detoxification and relaxation benefits.

Basti is considered one of the most important Panchakarma procedures for balancing Vata Dosha. It involves the administration of specially prepared herbal medicines through therapeutic methods under expert supervision.
✔ Helps manage joint and neurological disorders
Nasya involves the administration of medicated herbal oils through the nasal passages to cleanse and rejuvenate the head and neck region.
It is particularly beneficial for sinus-related conditions and mental wellness.
Virechana is a specialized cleansing therapy designed to eliminate excess toxins and balance Pitta Dosha through a controlled detoxification process.
Vamana is a classical Ayurvedic detoxification therapy primarily used to balance Kapha Dosha and remove excess toxins from the upper digestive and respiratory systems.
